candidate_claims.text: In Trends Stock Market Stocks to Watch LPG Price flydubai Nifty Outlook Gold and Silver Prices Today Oil Prices PM Narendra Modi congratulates Indian contingent after Asian Games campaign India finished at the fourth place on the medal table with 85 medals (21 gold, 27 silver, 37 bronze), 21 less than the last edition in Hangzhou, China.

By PTI October 5, 2026, 1:00:18 AM IST (Published) 1 Min Read Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Sunday congratulated the Indian contingent for its performance at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, praising the athletes for representing the country with determination, passion and sporting spirit.
India finished at the fourth place on the medal table with 85 medals (21 gold, 27 silver, 37 bronze), 21 less than the last edition in Hangzhou, China.

"As the Asian Games 2026 draw to a close, my compliments to every member of the Indian contingent for representing our nation with determination, passion and remarkable sporting spirit," Modi said in a post on X.
May they contribute to strengthening sports at the grassroots too," the prime minister added.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi to virtually inaugurate restored British-era Vellore Cantonment railway station on October 11

candidate_claims.text: | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement Prime Minister Narendra Modi will virtually inaugurate a restored British-era Vellore Cantonment railway station on October 11, during his visit to the State.
The station is located next to a 16th century fort complex in Vellore town.
Modi will inaugurate the station through video conferencing from Chennai, where he is expected to inaugurate various completed works of the Southern Railway in the State.

Railway officials said that the restoration work, which was started in 2023, was being done under the station redevelopment project, which aims to provide better passenger amenities, including separate arrival and departure corridors, bright LED lights, hassle-free access to platforms through escalators, lifts, skywalks and a rainwater harvesting system.
A total of 25 granite benches on the platforms were refurbished.

candidate_promises.text: As a result, the restored facility will provide better civic amenities to long-distance travellers,” said a railway official.
